sources.label: Official Sosandar Size Guide (Clothing & Swimwear, cm; International Conversion)

notes: UK womenswear brand targeting 35–60 demographic, sold via own site and John Lewis. Its size guide covers UK 6–26. Runs true — smart-casual and polished aesthetic with consistent sizing across collections. Body measurements published on size guide. Reliable for second-hand buying.
audit: Old /pages/size-guide 404s; guide is /size-guide/. Clothing & Swimwear chart prints UK 6-26 in inches and cm (printed cm used); US and BEL/FRA/NLD/POR (stored as EU) from the International Conversion. Old UK 10 88/69/94 -> 89/74/98; UK 14 97/78/103 -> 99/84/108; UK 20 114/95/120 -> 115.2/100.2/124.2. UK 6 and 22-26 added. Dual-size letters (S = 8 and 10) not stored as altLabel. John Lewis source dropped (retailer, not evidence). Notes corrected ('UK sizing 8–22' -> 6–26).
